title: Release train plan: console-2025.04 Route Experiments (flags, migrations, staged enablement)
creator: Connor O'Brien
content:
Overview
- This ticket coordinates the console-2025.04 release train work for Route-level Experiments (A/B/n) across: feature flags, migrations, staged enablement (internal -> beta accounts), and rollback playbook.
- Goal is a safe beta expansion with the new Console surfaces + routing/telemetry plumbing already merged, without accidentally enabling for all tenants/regions.

Release goals (console-2025.04)
1) Ship Console UI (list/details + creation wizard + results dashboard) behind flags.
2) Ensure control-plane config + routing evaluation is safe when partially enabled (no experiment config applied unless tenant is allowlisted).
3) Ensure telemetry/aggregation is deployed before any account enablement to avoid "empty" / misleading results.
4) Have an explicit, practiced rollback: kill switches, alerting, and comms.

Cut list (in-scope for this release train)
- Feature flag gates + allowlisting hooks (ref: PR redwood/pr-28673-add-feature-flag-route-experiments)
- Console pages behind FF (ref: PRs redwood/pr-28518, pr-28524, pr-28658)
- Results API + aggregation plumbing (ref: redwood/pr-28644, redwood/pr-28503)
- Guardrails soft-stop and notification path (ref: redwood/pr-28567). Hard-stop is optional and MUST be gated with a kill switch (ref: redwood/pr-28581).
- RBAC + audit events must be present for beta expansion (ref: redwood/pr-28552, redwood/pr-28539, redwood/pr-28719)

Explicit non-goals for console-2025.04
- No full statistical significance engine (WIP only; do not ship UI claims).
- No customer-managed custom metrics ingestion.
- No multi-region rebalancing beyond deterministic bucketing.

Feature flags (authoritative list for enablement)
- FF: route_experiments_console_ui
  - Controls visibility of Experiment pages (List/Details/Create/Results) in Console.
- FF: route_experiments_policy_evaluator
  - Controls request routing assignment (policy engine evaluator path).
- FF: route_experiments_results_api
  - Controls results/deltas endpoint usage in Console.
- FF: route_experiments_beta_allowlist
  - Tenant/account allowlist gate. Must be checked in BOTH Console backend and policy evaluator.
- Kill switch: route_experiments_auto_stop_enabled
  - Defaults OFF for beta expansion; if enabled, only for specific allowlisted tenants after SRE sign-off.

Staged enablement plan
Phase A: Pre-prod validation (staging)
- Deploy all services + migrations to staging.
- Run smoke: create experiment, start, observe deterministic assignment and headers, confirm attribution appears in traces + rollups.
- Validate known risk areas:
  - attribution drop rate on streaming + retries
  - propagation lag metrics present
  - variant skew behavior when stickiness key missing (should warn + safe default)

Phase B: Internal dogfood (prod, Redwood-only)
- Enable for Redwood internal tenant(s) only:
  - route_experiments_beta_allowlist = ["redwood-internal"]
  - route_experiments_console_ui = ON
  - route_experiments_policy_evaluator = ON
  - route_experiments_results_api = ON
- Watch for 24h:
  - attribution drop rate
  - config propagation lag
  - results query cost / DB load
  - cardinality regressions

Phase C: Beta design partners (prod)
- Expand allowlist incrementally (no more than 2 new accounts per day):
  - Acme AI (design partner)
  - Northbridge (POC)
  - Helio Financial (security-sensitive; enable only after audit export verification)
- Region rollout: us-east -> us-west -> eu-west. Do not enable eu-west until skew fix has been verified in that region.
- Guardrails:
  - Soft-stop only for the first week of expansion
  - Hard-stop kill switch remains OFF

Phase D: Broader beta expansion (post-release, after go/no-go)
- Run the beta success criteria checklist (see PM-482 + Beta Program Plan) before adding additional accounts.

Migration & data readiness plan
1) Config schema + versioning
- Ensure config persistence migration and schema versioning are deployed prior to allowlisting any external tenant (ref: redwood/pr-28692-data-migration-experiment-config-versioning).
- Backwards compatibility: old configs should continue to validate; Console should surface actionable validation errors.

2) Telemetry schema and rollups
- Confirm experiment attribution fields are emitted on OTel spans and key request metrics (ref: redwood/pr-28489, redwood/pr-28470).
- Confirm analytics rollup jobs/tables are deployed before results dashboard is enabled (ref: redwood/pr-28503).
- If schema changes are required late, coordinate backfill job throttling and cost estimate (ref: ENG-9034).

3) Cardinality guardrails
- Verify reduced tagging strategy is live before broad enablement (ref: redwood/pr-28741).
- Alert if metrics cost or series count spikes after enablement.

Operational readiness (SRE)
- Required dashboards/alerts must be live and linked from the runbook:
  - propagation lag/staleness
  - attribution drop rate
  - variant 0 traffic detection
  - per-variant latency/error/cost guardrails
- Confirm runbooks are reviewed with oncall rotation (ref: ENG-9033).
- Confirm escalation policy for experiment-related incidents and who can flip kill switches.

Rollback plan
- Primary rollback: disable route_experiments_beta_allowlist for the affected tenant(s).
- Secondary rollback: disable route_experiments_policy_evaluator globally (keeps Console UI read-only if desired).
- Tertiary rollback: disable route_experiments_console_ui and route_experiments_results_api.
- For auto-stop issues: force route_experiments_auto_stop_enabled OFF (global) and acknowledge incident.
- Notes:
  - Migrations are forward-only; rollback is via flags, not DB downgrades.
  - Ensure audit logs capture who flipped flags / made config changes (enterprise requirement).

Comms plan
- Internal:
  - Post release note in #eng-releases with the enablement checklist + who to page for issues.
  - Notify Support + CS of variant header semantics and troubleshooting pointers.
- External (beta):
  - Provide enablement confirmation + short "first experiment" checklist.
  - Share known limitations (no stat-sig; quality signals are optional/sampled).

Acceptance criteria
- Feature flags exist, are documented, and gates are enforced in BOTH Console backend and policy evaluator.
- Migrations for config versioning and rollups are executed in prod prior to beta expansion.
- Staged enablement completed: internal dogfood + at least one beta tenant enabled successfully.
- Dashboards/alerts live; runbook links embedded in alerts.
- Rollback steps tested (flag flip drill) and documented.

References
- PM-482: GA requirements / cross-team checklist
- Confluence ADRs: deterministic bucketing + metrics attribution schema
- GitHub: redwood/pr-28673 (feature flag), redwood/pr-28692 (config versioning), redwood/pr-28658 (results dashboard)
- Slack threads: feature flag plan for beta enablement; GA rollout plan region-by-region
comments: 2025-03-14 (Connor O'Brien): Drafted initial cut list for console-2025.04. Waiting on confirmation whether hard-stop ships as gated beta-only (SRE prefers OFF by default).
2025-03-20 (Sean Gallagher): SRE sign-off condition: propagation lag alert + attribution drop rate alert must be live before adding >1 external tenant. Also require kill switch for auto-stop.
2025-03-27 (Logan Wright): Telemetry rollups are ready in staging. Note: results query cost spike seen in staging; recommend enabling results dashboard only after caching patch lands.
2025-04-02 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): RBAC gates merged for mutation endpoints. Confirmed allowlist check is applied server-side (not just UI).

2025-04-09 (Connor O'Brien): Ran prod dogfood enablement for redwood-internal. No routing regressions observed; attribution drop alert fired once on streaming retries, resolved by hotfix already in pr-28622.
2025-04-15 (Connor O'Brien): Enabled Acme AI in us-east only. Held eu-west enablement pending validation of skew fix and propagation lag thresholds tuning.
2025-04-23 (Connor O'Brien): Release train closed. Flags remain allowlist-only. Next step tracked in PM-482 for broader beta expansion and GA go/no-go.
